| [TERM-087](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-087.md) v5 | cut, and which sense: a Cartesian cut, Pattee's epistemic cut, or Barad's agential cut, enacted by an apparatus | Three senses of "cut" the exchange of 2026-10-27 used, which A9 §4 said "are not interchangeable concepts". The Cartesian cut is a separation of observer from observed taken as given before any measurement. Pattee's epistemic cut ([LIT-1190](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-1190.md), read in [NOTE-952](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-952.md)) is the functional separation of symbolic description from the dynamics it measures or controls, and is epistemic, not ontological. Barad's agential cut (read first-hand only in her 2012 essay, LIT-1869; LIT-1653 and LIT-1657 unavailable) is a differentiation enacted within a phenomenon by an apparatus, through which boundaries and properties become determinate. Proposed: the record had no word for them, and they recur in [CLAIM-476](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-476.md). | Proposed |
| [TERM-089](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-089.md) v5 | apparatus, in the operational sense: a realized organization that selectively couples differences in one system to distinguishable outcomes in another; by function it may differentiate, retain, enforce and revise, and the four come apart | The sense of "apparatus" the exchange of 2026-10-27 converged on from U19 to U23, stated so that no observer and no constitutive metaphysics is presupposed. An apparatus makes some differences in a system produce distinct outcomes in another (differentiation), and may keep them (retention), let them change what happens next (enforcement), and change its own criteria of discrimination (revision). Adopted on 2026-10-27 because the record uses "apparatus" in [CLAIM-476](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-476.md) and [TERM-087](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-087.md) in Barad's sense, and needed a weaker one that a thermometer, a bacterium, a sensor network and luria all fall under without argument. | Active |
